You may have a concussion if you've experienced a blow to the head or a jolt to the body that has caused symptoms such as: 

1. Confusion or disorientation
2. Memory loss or difficulty remembering things
3. Dizziness or loss of balance
4. Headache or pressure in the head
5. Nausea or vomiting
6. Blurred vision or sensitivity to light
7. Ringing in the ears or hearing loss
8. Fatigue or feeling tired
9. Irritability or mood changes
10. Difficulty concentrating or paying attention

If you're experiencing any of these symptoms after a head injury, seek medical attention immediately. A healthcare professional can evaluate you and provide a proper diagnosis and treatment plan.
